name: Phantom Siita Bakka -Daiichiyo Makuake-
original_name: ファントムシータばっか -第一夜 幕開ケ-
overview: Phantom Siita, an idol group produced by Ado, operates under the concept of terrifying yet beautiful “retro horror.” They released their 1st single “Otomodachi” in June 2024 and held their first solo concert at Tokyo's Nippon Budokan in November of the same year, making them a hot topic right after their debut! An M-ON! original program packed with their charm will air for two consecutive months! Look forward to seeing a side of Phantom Siita you can only see here!
